# UX Requirements Checklist: Split Diff Viewer

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for split diff parsing, rendering, and accessible interaction  
**Created**: 2026-09-30  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `$speckit-checklist` based on Feature 012 requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is reviewer-owned. A reviewer marks `[x]` only after confirming the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements quality was reviewed; it does not mean implementation is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are old-side and new-side responsibilities and labels explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are independent line-number rules for context, added, and removed rows stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are replacement alignment and unequal block behavior bounded to deterministic positional pairing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all required patch metadata cases covered without consuming source line numbers? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are binary, too-large, empty, truncated, malformed, and incomplete-file-list states specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the changed-file sidebar and no-refetch-on-file-switch requirements explicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, FR-008]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Is malformed patch handling distinguished clearly from an explicitly truncated final hunk? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK008 Are `filesCompleteness` semantics kept separate from per-file patch truncation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the `Difference` icon preference and accessible fallback policy explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the Finding ID the only diff lookup identity and the on-demand request boundary clear? [Security, Spec §FR-012–FR-013]

## Accessibility and Responsive Scenarios

- [ ] CHK011 Are non-color addition/removal semantics and accessible Before/After labels defined? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-007, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK012 Are keyboard activation, dialog close, file navigation, and focus restoration requirements covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK013 Are long-line containment and narrow-screen split behavior clear without an implicit unified-mode switch? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK014 Are loading, safe rendering error, and existing retry behavior retained in the interaction requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, FR-017]

## Scope and Acceptance Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Is the frontend-only boundary explicit, including no API, retrieval, persistence, migration, or detection-rule change? [Scope, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK016 Can each success criterion be assessed from user-visible behavior and deterministic parser cases? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-006]

## Notes

- Checklist markers are left unchecked for reviewer assessment.
- `$speckit-implement` must not modify reviewer-owned checklist markers.

## Visual Reference Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Does the plan identify the reference image as layout guidance while keeping the written specification authoritative? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001–FR-016]
- [ ] CHK018 Are modal metadata, the persistent file sidebar, selected-file state, and split Before/After areas all represented in the written requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the reference's decorative controls or metrics explicitly excluded unless independently required by the specification? [Scope, Plan §Visual Reference]
- [ ] CHK020 Are line-number gutters, hunk separators, file change type, and addition/removal semantics described clearly enough to guide layout without inferring extra behavior from the mock? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003–FR-007]
